scope: Read-only D1 source and original synthetic/native/reporter/collector evidence review. No test, comparator, Docker or remote operation.
prior_failure_boundary: D1 synthetic load/registration complete, child exit0, only parent file-level PASS; required individual case completion event absent. Original missing-event cause undetermined.
native_control_requirements: CommonJS fixture with exactly one explicitly named node:test registration and arithmetic assertion; no preloads/custom reporter/collector code in the native test process.
Direct /usr/bin/node --test --test-reporter=tap with exact fixture target and separate raw stdout/stderr preservation.
Positive requires exact case-name PASS and exit0.
Negative requires exact case-name FAIL, arithmetic ERR_ASSERTION evidence at fixture location and nonzero exit; arbitrary process/file failure is insufficient.
First native failure stops immediately without later native or wrapped controls.
Matched positive/negative D1 path comparisons allowed only after both native controls pass; no assertion/source drift.
Any native-only absence limits localization to a path that excludes D1 observation instrumentation; it does not itself identify a Node/fixture/environment defect.
No comparator execution, production/package change, Docker, historical volume operation or remote action.
independent_disposition: BASELINE_AND_DESIGN_BOUNDARIES_RECONSTRUCTED; actual controls and causal review pending
